name: Google Gemini
description: Google Gemini chat-completion provider (and shared API key for the gemini-embedder plugin). Claims the 'gemini' model prefix (e.g. 'gemini/gemini-2.5-flash'). Owns the GEMINI_API_KEY config slot — gemini-embedder reads from this plugin via its `depends` declaration. Backfills from the legacy host-level `geminiApiKey` / GEMINI_API_KEY env on first install. Multimodal (vision/audio/video) capable.
